title: Coreweave Akamai and Crusoe to Offer Perplexity SPACE AI Sandbox

tickers.name: CoreWeave, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
A new series of partnerships will allow AI developers to access secure execution environments for autonomous agents through cloud infrastructure providers. Coreweave, Akamai, and Crusoe have agreed to offer Perplexity's open source SPACE sandbox to their customers to raise the security bar for agentic products. Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas stated that neoclouds must own a full inference platform rather than simply leasing GPUs to support the production grade traffic needed to scale agents for businesses.

SPACE is the first component of Perplexity's Agentic Runtime Platform and is available under an Apache 2.0 license. The software uses Firecracker microVMs to run agent tasks, controlling credentials and outbound traffic from outside the virtual machine to prevent host breaches. In security testing, 9 model configurations with root access made 108 escape attempts, none of which succeeded. The platform currently powers Perplexity Computer and the company's internal reinforcement learning training and evaluation workloads.
